description: Create or update a scheduled action for an Auto Scaling Group. A new scheduledActionName creates one; to update, pass scheduledActionNo or the existing name. Set startTime for a one-off run, recurrence (cron) for a repeating one, or both.

desiredCapacity.description: Desired number of servers at the scheduled time (between minSize and maxSize; defaults to minSize)

endTime.description: End time, yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ — after startTime; with recurrence, repeats stop after it

maxSize.description: Maximum number of servers at the scheduled time (0-30)

minSize.description: Minimum number of servers at the scheduled time (0-30)

recurrence.description: Repeat schedule in crontab format 'min hour day month weekday' (e.g. '0 9 * * 1-5' = weekdays 09:00). Required when startTime is not set.

scheduledActionName.description: Scheduled action name (1-255 chars: lowercase letters, digits, '-'). A new name creates an action; an existing name updates it. One of scheduledActionNo / scheduledActionName is required.

scheduledActionNo.description: Scheduled action number to update (from ncloud_list_scheduled_actions). Omit when creating.

startTime.description: Start time, yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (e.g. 2026-12-01T09:00:00+0900). Must be in the future. Required when recurrence is not set.

timeZone.description: Time zone for recurrence: KST (default) or UTC

name: ncloud_put_scheduled_action
